datasets.name: ALOS PALSAR Digital Elevation Model (DEM)
datasets.verbatim: The DEM was downloaded from Alaska Satellite Facility website (https://www.asf.alaska.edu/).

methods.name: Proposed method for semi-automated landslide detection
methods.summary: The proposed method uses multi-resolution segmentation (MRS) with scale parameters determined by the ESP-2 tool, followed by a rule-based classification using spectral (NDVI, NDWI, Mean Brightness), morphological, and topographical parameters to identify and refine landslide objects.
methods.verbatim: Therefore, an alternate (proposed) method is developed for semi-automated landslide detection.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not referenced or linked, and the SPOT-6 imagery is a commercial dataset without access. The proposed custom method code is not provided or linked.
